title: Mobile Engineer - React Native
description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Mobile Engineer - React Native based in Turkey. Join a fully remote engineering team building innovative peer-to-peer mobile technology for secure, decentralized communication. In this role, you will develop and enhance a cross-platform application for iOS and Android using React Native and Expo. You will work on features spanning messaging, voice and video calls, media sharing, device pairing, and identity backup. Combining modern mobile development with an on-device peer-to-peer architecture, you will help deliver a seamless, reliable, and privacy-focused user experience. You will collaborate closely with product, design, and core technology teams to build high-quality features from concept to release. This opportunity is ideal for an experienced mobile engineer passionate about performance optimization, decentralized technologies, and shaping the future of digital communication. Accountabilities Develop and maintain a cross-platform peer-to-peer mobile application, taking ownership of features from implementation through testing and release. Ensure the application delivers a reliable, responsive, and secure experience across iOS and Android. Build, refine, and maintain features for messaging, voice and video calls, media sharing, device pairing, and identity backup. Implement user interfaces and connect them to the peer-to-peer core APIs running directly on the device. Integrate native mobile capabilities, including push notifications, camera access, biometric authentication, and background tasks. Profile and optimize performance on real devices, focusing on application startup time, extended chat sessions, media processing, battery consumption, and network usage. Write and maintain unit and end-to-end tests to ensure application reliability and prevent regressions. Support stable releases through continuous integration workflows, crash reporting, and systematic debugging. Collaborate with product, design, and peer-to-peer engineering teams to deliver new features and improve the overall user experience. Participate in code reviews, promote engineering best practices, and maintain a high standard of code quality. Requirements Candidates should bring substantial experience in React Native development, strong JavaScript expertise, and a solid understanding of mobile application architecture and state management. The ideal candidate is comfortable working independently in a remote environment, optimizing existing applications, and collaborating across technical disciplines. Significant professional experience with React Native and mobile application development. Strong experience with Redux for state management and Redux-Saga for handling asynchronous workflows. High proficiency in JavaScript, including ES6+ features and modern development practices. Experience integrating and working with WebSockets and RESTful APIs. Familiarity with mobile application performance optimization, debugging, and testing. Experience collaborating with distributed or fully remote engineering teams. An interest in modernizing, improving, and optimizing mobile or web applications. Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and the ability to communicate effectively in English. Familiarity with native development languages such as Swift and Kotlin is an advantage. Experience with native development and build tools, including Xcode and Android Studio, is a plus. Experience building applications with peer-to-peer frameworks or working with decentralized technologies is a bonus. Benefits Fully remote working arrangement, with worldwide opportunities. Opportunity to contribute to innovative peer-to-peer technology and privacy-focused mobile applications. Collaboration with an international team of engineers and product specialists. Exposure to modern mobile development practices and a distinctive on-device peer-to-peer architecture. Opportunity to take ownership of end-to-end features and make a meaningful impact on product development. Professional growth through challenging engineering projects involving mobile performance, decentralized communication, and cross-platform development. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team. We appreciate your interest and wish you the best! Why Apply Through Jobgether? title: Backend Developer
description: Biz Kimiz Supplementler.com, 2012 yılında kurulan Dikey Vitamin A.Ş.’nin sporcu gıdaları ve takviyeleri alanında faaliyet gösteren öncü ve lider markasıdır. Dikey Vitamin, Supplementler.com ile birlikte spor, sağlıklı yaşam ve beslenme kategorilerinde üç e-ticaret sitesinin operasyonunu sürdürmektedir. Vitaminler.com: Vitamin, mineral ve sağlıklı atıştırmalık ürünleri Fitmoda.com: Spor ekipmanları, aksesuarları ve tekstil ürünleri Dikey Vitamin, sektörün önde gelen global markalarının yanı sıra yerel üretimle geliştirdiği kendi markalarını da tüketicilerle buluşturmaktadır. Teknoloji Operasyonları ekibimize %100 uzaktan çalışma modeliyle çalışacak Mid Level Backend Developer (.Net) arıyoruz. Teknik Yolculuğumuz Uzun yıllardır üretimde olan .Net FW tabanlı platformumuzu, sistemi canlıda çalışır tutarak modüler monolith mimariye taşıyoruz. Hedefimiz net: bounded context'leri bugünden servis sınırı olacak şekilde tasarlamak ve olgunlaşan modülleri mikroservislere ayırmak. İlk mikroservislerimiz şimdiden canlıda. Bu dönüşümde kullandıklarımız: Domain-Driven Design — aggregate, value object, domain event, bounded context; kitaptan değil, üretimde Clean Architecture — katman sınırları mimari testlerle (architecture tests) otomatik korunuyor Event-driven mimari — domain event'ler ve dış servislerle adapter tabanlı entegrasyon CQRS tarzı use case yapısı — MediatR, FluentValidation SQL Server + Entity Framework, Elasticsearch, Hangfire Yani burada hem yeşil alan (yeni modüller, yeni servisler) hem kahverengi alan (legacy dönüşümü) mühendisliği bir arada: ikisini de seven biriyseniz doğru yerdesiniz. Neler Yapacaksın Legacy proje üzerindeki iş akışlarını analiz edip modüler monolith'e kademeli olarak taşınması sürecinde aktif rol alacaksın (strangler fig yaklaşımı) İş kurallarını domain modeline doğru yansıtarak yeni özellikleri DDD ve Clean Architecture prensipleriyle, modül sınırlarını gözeterek geliştireceksin Modüllerin bağımsız deploy edilebilir servislere dönüşme sürecinde tasarım kararlarına katkı sağlayacaksın ERP, pazaryeri, ödeme ve arama (Elasticsearch) entegrasyonlarını geliştirecek ve iyileştireceksin Agentic coding araçlarını geliştirme süreçlerinde etkin biçimde kullanacak, ekip içinde bu pratiklerin geliştirilmesine katkı sağlayacaksın Code review süreçlerine aktif olarak katılacak, mimari standartların korunmasına katkı sağlayacak, junior geliştiricilerle bilgi paylaşımında bulunacaksın Yüksek trafik altında performans ve ölçeklenebilirlik problemlerinin çözümünde ekiple birlikte çalışacaksın Aranan Nitelikler Backend geliştirmede 3+ yıl deneyim; C#/.NET ekosisteminde güçlü teknik bilgi birikimi (.NET Framework ve/veya modern .NET deneyimi) DDD kavramlarını (aggregate, value object, domain event, bounded context) iyi derecede bilmek ve gerçek projelerde uygulamış olmak; üretim ortamı deneyimi tercih sebebidir Clean Architecture / Ports & Adapters prensiplerine dair bilgi ve deneyim; SOLID prensiplerinin ezbere değil gerekçeleriyle bilinmesi Legacy kod tabanında refactoring deneyimi ve kademeli dönüşüm süreçlerinde yer alma isteği SQL Server ve ORM (Entity Framework vb.) deneyimi; sorgu performansı bilinci Event-driven mimariler ve asenkron iletişim kalıpları hakkında bilgi Test yazma kültürü (xUnit vb.) ve test edilebilir tasarım alışkanlığı Agentic coding araçlarıyla (Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot vb.) günlük geliştirme deneyimi; üretilen kodu eleştirel bakışla değerlendirip testlerle doğrulayabilme Teknik kararları yazılı ve sözlü olarak net ifade edebilme; code review süreçlerine yapıcı katılım Bunlar Varsa Harika Olur E-ticaret domain deneyimi (sepet, kampanya, ödeme, sipariş, stok akışları) NopCommerce veya benzeri bir e-ticaret platformu deneyimi Monolith'ten mikroservise geçiş sürecinde yer almış olmak CQRS / MediatR deneyimi Elasticsearch deneyimi Mesaj kuyruğu sistemleri (RabbitMQ, Kafka vb.) Hangfire veya benzeri background job altyapıları ERP / pazaryeri entegrasyon deneyimi Agentic workflow kurgulama deneyimi (MCP, özel agent/prompt tasarımı, AI destekli code review) Mühendislik Kültürümüz Mimari sınırlar sözde kalmaz; architecture test'lerle CI'da otomatik doğrulanır Teknik borç bilinçli alınır, kodda açıkça işaretlenir ve çıkış koşuluyla takip edilir Yazılı convention'larımız var: exception ve mesaj kodları, use case versiyonlama, modül sınırı kuralları Yeni geliştirmeleri hızlıca deneyebileceğin izole bir Playground ortamı sunuyoruz Code review zorunludur ve standartlar herkese eşit uygulanır Agentic coding araçlarını geliştirme süreçlerimizde aktif olarak kullanıyor, deneyimlerimizi ekip içinde paylaşıyoruz

title: Frontend Developer (React)
description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Frontend Developer (React) based in Turkey. Join a product-focused development team building innovative web applications that deliver meaningful value to users and businesses. As a Frontend Developer (React), you will contribute to the design, development, and continuous improvement of modern, interactive, and high-performance user interfaces. You will collaborate closely with web developers and technology leadership, balancing ongoing product support with new feature development. This role offers significant autonomy, allowing you to influence technical decisions, shape application architecture, and introduce tools and practices that improve development efficiency. You will work in an environment that values code quality, innovation, and continuous learning. With a strong emphasis on collaboration and ownership, this opportunity offers room to expand your technical expertise while contributing to products with real-world impact. Accountabilities Collaborate with the web development team and technology leadership to deliver product features, improvements, and technical solutions, allocating approximately 70% of your time to development and 30% to support activities. Design, develop, and maintain interactive, responsive, and high-performance web applications using React. Contribute to selecting and implementing appropriate tools, technologies, frameworks, and development methodologies. Design and implement scalable, maintainable frontend application architectures aligned with product requirements. Build efficient user interfaces using React hooks, TypeScript, modern JavaScript, and established frontend development practices. Manage application state using Redux, Flux, or other appropriate state management approaches. Develop and optimize CSS, ensuring maintainable styling, efficient rendering, and consistent user experiences across interfaces. Integrate frontend applications with backend services through REST APIs and apply relevant service-oriented architecture concepts. Conduct code reviews, maintain high coding standards, and promote best practices across the development team. Identify and resolve technical issues, optimize application performance, and improve code quality where needed. Support continuous integration and continuous delivery workflows and contribute to improving development processes. Collaborate with team members to troubleshoot issues, maintain existing functionality, and deliver new features efficiently. Requirements At least three years of professional experience developing web applications, including a minimum of two years working with React.js. Strong proficiency in React and experience building interactive, responsive, and performant user interfaces. Solid understanding of object-oriented programming and functional programming principles and design patterns. Practical experience with React hooks, TypeScript, and modern frontend application architecture. Experience with state management libraries and patterns, particularly Redux or Flux. Familiarity with CI/CD principles, tools, and workflows. Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, attention to detail, and a commitment to writing clean, maintainable code. Ability to work independently, collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams, and take ownership of technical decisions. Nice to have: Experience working on high-traffic or high-load applications. Nice to have: Familiarity with Node.js and backend development. Nice to have: Strong knowledge of SOLID principles, software design patterns, and distributed application architecture. Nice to have: Experience with Docker containers and setting up development environments. Nice to have: Familiarity with Linux-based operating systems and Bash scripting. Benefits Flexible work arrangements: Choose between remote work and office-based work, with the flexibility to work from anywhere and support for setting up your workspace. Remote onboarding: A structured remote onboarding experience to help you integrate smoothly into the team. Performance bonuses: Annual or quarterly performance-based bonuses, depending on the role. Learning and development: Access to a company learning library, internal educational resources, and training programs offered by external partners. Health and life insurance: Insurance coverage designed to support your health and well-being. Wellbeing support: Access to a wellbeing program and a corporate psychologist. Mobile communication reimbursement: Reimbursement of eligible mobile communication expenses.
